eyebrow: Hakomi and body-centered work for adults
headline: The future you’re longing for begins within.
introduction: When painful experiences quietly organize life beneath the surface, moving forward can feel difficult even when you understand the pattern. There is another way to listen.
locationLine: Online and in person on Kauaʻi
coreStatement: Through Hakomi and mindful, body-centered therapy, I create a safe permission structure where difficult emotions can finally be felt, met, and transformed.
practitionerStatement: I hold a permission structure that helps people feel what has been too scary to feel. I meet them there and accompany them where they need to go.
